env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# An expression of tuple type destructures into its elements, or is
# returned to a function with that many results, whatever form the
# expression has: a variable, a parenthesised variable, a field, a slice
# element, a call that returns one tuple value, an option coalesced with
# a default, an optional selector coalesced with a default, a map read
# coalesced with a default, and a switch expression. The host is a short
# declaration, an assignment, a var declaration or a return. The module
# runs natively, ejects, and the ejected module builds and runs with go
# and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints the same ok lines.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_expressions.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_expressions.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_expressions.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_expressions.out
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tupledestructureexpressions

go 1.27
